remarks: Welcome, to Kingsley Court, a beautifully maintained community in the heart of Norwalk offering both convenience and charm. This fully renovated 1-bedroom, 1-bath unit is move-in ready and ideal as a comfortable primary residence or an investment opportunity. Step inside to a bright, open layout perfect for entertaining. The unit features a spacious bedroom, updated bath, custom closet, hardwood floors and generous storage. Thoughtful, neutral design choices create a clean, modern feel ready for your personal touch. Tucked away within the complex, the unit offers a peaceful, private setting. Residents enjoy assigned parking, well-kept landscaped grounds, and convenient on-site laundry. Just a short walk to Norwalk Hospital, with easy access to I-95, the Route 7 connector, public transportation, and a wide variety of shopping and dining options. A rare combination of location, condition, and value. Located behind Jefferson Elementary School.
